title: Create friend.ipynb Colab Notebook

acceptance_criteria.1_seven_cells: Notebook has 7 cells: cell 1 (markdown instructions), cell 2 (GitHub token), cell 3 (bootstrap), cell 4 (install), cell 5 (import/config), cell 6 (run pipeline), cell 7 (markdown results).
acceptance_criteria.2_bootstrap_discovers: Bootstrap cell discovers project root, mounts Drive, finds CSVs. Uses /content/friend_project as GITHUB_CLONE_DIR.
acceptance_criteria.3_install_colab_gpu: Install cell installs JAX CUDA 12, EvoX, Torch CPU on Colab; falls back to requirements.txt locally. Same pin set as main.ipynb.
acceptance_criteria.4_import_config: Import cell sets PER_SYMBOL_PHASE2=True, PHASE5_REMOVE_NEGATIVE_PNL_RULES=True, configures JAX, reports GPU info, sets PHASE2_SCAN_UNROLL=16 for Colab RAM.
acceptance_criteria.5_run_sync: Run cell executes pipeline with --output to local scratch (/content/friend_project_outputs), syncs to Drive (MyDrive/friend_project/outputs). Pools/per_symbol and phase2_rule_archive also synced.
acceptance_criteria.6_numba_ops_graceful: _repair_stale_numba_ops() returns 'numba_ops.py not present (friend_project)' when file doesn't exist (friend_project may not have it).
acceptance_criteria.7_friend_paths: All paths reference friend_project (not main project). No references to /content/trading_platform.
acceptance_criteria.8_valid_json: Notebook JSON is valid Jupyter format (nbformat 4, nbformat_minor 5). Validated with json.load.
